Recover [[Jun]]'s [[Jun's Art Supplies|art supplies]] from the thieving Dredge.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill the [[Sly Dredge]] who stole Jun's art supplies
* See Jun for your reward

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 750 [[Kurzick Faction]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* [[Equipment Requisition]]

==Walkthrough==
The Sly Dredge is found in [[Melandru's Hope]]. Head northeast from [[Lutgardis Conservatory]] or, if it is unlocked, west from [[Jade Flats (Kurzick)]] and follow the quest pointer to the Sly Dredge.  The Sly Dredge will usually be accompanied by a group of 5-6 other Dredge.

The quest is completed once you return Jun's Art Supplies to Jun in House zu Heltzer.

==NPCs==
===Foes===
[[Dredge]]
*{{a}} 24 (26) [[Sly Dredge]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Jun
:''"I was painting the other day by the lake near '''Ferndale'''. A group of Dredge attacked me, and i had to flee. A Dredge, a '''sly Dredge''' if ever there was one, stole my art supplies, of all things! I don't know what it wanted with them, but they were really expensive...a gift from the Kurzick master who trained me in the arts. Please, can you retrieve my stolen '''art supplies'''?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I have always been a supporter of the arts.
|decline = No. I think you need to suffer for your art.
|ask = The '''sly Dredge''' stole my '''art supplies''' near '''Melandru's Hope'''. 
|indent = :: }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Jun
:''"Thank you so much! Tell [[Kisai]] that I said "hello," and remind my sister that I believe in her...even if she doesn't. Please accept some of these fine paints as a token of my gratitude."''
